title: Surface Tension
definition: Surface tension is the elastic tendency of fluid surfaces which makes them acquire the least possible surface area, resulting from the unbalanced cohesive forces acting on liquid molecules at the surface interface.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims (GS-1 Physics applications, biological phenomena like capillary action, cleaning action of soaps) and forms foundational base for materials science and fluid mechanics in Mains Science & Technology.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Surface Tension.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
